Garlic Butter Shrimp

Yield: 3 servings

Ingredients
- 1 pound large shrimp
- 4 tablespoons butter, divided
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon paprika
- ½ teaspoon kosher salt
- ¼ cup white wine
- 2 tablespoons parsley

Preparation
1. Toss the shrimp with the paprika and salt.
2. Melt some of the butter in a skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Cook 3 minutes per side, until pink.
4. Add the garlic, wine and the rest of the butter, stirring until melted.
5. Sprinkle with the parsley.
